continuous_variables: penetration_ratio = distance_inside_level / ATR20 (continuous, never binarised first)
bars_inside_level (running count inside the band episode)
max_excursion_inside_level (running max of penetration_ratio within the episode)

penetration_definitions_compared.PEN_DEF_FORMAL: in_band AND penetration_ratio >= boundary  (requires the touch band)
penetration_definitions_compared.PEN_DEF_GEOMETRY_ONLY: close crossed to the opposite side of level_price (side flip); does NOT require the touch band

natural_separation_rules_preregistered.density_valley_rule: NATURAL_SEPARATION only if two local maxima exist >= 0.15 ATR apart, each >= 5% of sample mass, separated by a local minimum with density <= 0.5 x min(peak_left, peak_right)
natural_separation_rules_preregistered.mixture_diagnostic: fit 1- and 2-component Gaussian mixtures on log(penetration_ratio); a structural split requires delta_BIC(1->2) >= 10 AND component mean separation >= 0.15 ATR AND the implied split point to lie within the observed support
natural_separation_rules_preregistered.monotone_rule: if the density over the support is unimodal or monotonically non-increasing -> NO_NATURAL_SEPARATION

temporal_blocks_preregistered.method: equal thirds of the touch-episode sequence in time order (EARLY/MIDDLE/LATE)

circularity_guard: PENETRATION -> BREAK_ATTEMPT / EXHAUSTION transition frequencies are DESCRIPTIVE ONLY and must never be used as the sole proof that PENETRATION is a legitimate state (task 17)

decision_rules_preregistered.GEOMETRIC_INDEPENDENCE: NO if penetration is structurally conditional on TOUCH (P(PEN|NOT_TOUCH)=0) AND expressible as a threshold on one continuous variable
decision_rules_preregistered.PERSISTENCE_INDEPENDENCE: NO if shadow-episode durations change smoothly/monotonically with the boundary and no boundary produces a distinct duration regime
decision_rules_preregistered.TRANSITION_STRUCTURE: INCONCLUSIVE by construction when the ONLY available evidence is the circular PENETRATION->BREAK chain
decision_rules_preregistered.NATURAL_DENSITY_SEPARATION: from the pre-registered valley + mixture rules
decision_rules_preregistered.TEMPORAL_STABILITY: YES if the 3 blocks have overlapping IQRs and medians within 0.10 ATR; NO if monotone drift or disjoint IQRs; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
decision_rules_preregistered.LEVEL_TYPE_STABILITY: YES if PIVOT and RANGE medians differ by < 0.15 ATR; NO if >= 0.15 ATR; INCONCLUSIVE if either n < 30
decision_rules_preregistered.DIRECTION_STABILITY: same rule on UP_LEVEL vs DN_LEVEL
decision_rules_preregistered.COUNTER_EVIDENCE: WEAKEN if >= 3 of the 5 counter-evidence questions answer YES; SUPPORT if <= 1 answers YES; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise
